commission: Harden the existing primary-phone ingress/recovery path so SSH and Home Center relay health cannot report false green before the Chromium phone campaign consumes the lane.

commissionBoundary.executionLane: existing Home Center Phone Hands / phone SSH guardian / relay recovery only
excluded: runtime success claims from repository state
commissionBoundary.evidenceStandard: Repository readback proves source repair only. Physical acceptance still requires primary-phone devices -> phone_shell -> observe -> home -> observe receipts through Home Center.

home_center_phone_relay_recover.sh could return success for a process without current Home Center poll proof and could accept a stale historical online log line

selectedJarRationale.00-judgement-jar-mission-boundary: Prevent a new ingress/control architecture or browser work from leaking into this lane.
selectedJarRationale.20-judgement-jar-repository-truth: Keep source implementation evidence separate from physical phone callability.
selectedJarRationale.40-judgement-jar-failure-recovery: Require bounded restart and fail-closed health instead of PID theater.
selectedJarRationale.70-judgement-jar-venice-review-gate: Repair the process-gate regression before integration.
selectedJarRationale.80-judgement-jar-daemon-backoff-persiste: Make daemon liveness depend on fresh successful work rather than process existence.

antagonism: An sshd PID is not an SSH listener and must never satisfy listener health.
A relay PID is not Home Center connectivity and must never satisfy relay health.
A stale old 'online' log line must not validate a new relay process.
Relay heartbeat must contain no reusable device secret, bearer token, or pairing material.
Heartbeat must bind to primary-phone, exact PID, recent successful Home Center poll, and bounded age.
Recovery may restart an unproven duplicate relay but may not create a neighboring daemon or queue.
Repository mutation and a PR remain candidate implementation only until physical phone receipts exist.
GitHub Actions budget failure cannot be treated as phone failure and cannot be used as phone acceptance.

quarantine.note: Initial candidate commits were created before this explicit addendum receipt. They remain quarantined candidate source and are not eligible for merge/deploy until reviewed against this receipt.

findings: The requested repair stays inside the established phone ingress lane.
Listener/banner proof and fresh poll heartbeats directly repair known false-green failure modes.
No secret needs to enter the heartbeat or receipt.
Physical canary remains mandatory and cannot be replaced by source review.
conditions: Review the candidate diff against this exact receipt before merge.
Fail closed when listener or Home Center poll liveness cannot be proven.
Preserve physical primary-phone canary as the deployment/callability gate.
Do not ask Drew to type a recovery command while an authorized machine lane remains available.
